items.title: Dan Wall and Adam Nussbaum interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 19, 2001
items.q: With this band we played some of Adam’s tunes, we played a lot of my tunes which has been really nice

ctx.x: You have a pretty good percentage of original material in the trio. Is it a challenge to get your own pieces played these days, other than doing it yourself?

Well the couple of organ records that I’ve done lately I think have been almost all my tunes but maybe a couple of standards. With this band we played some of Adam’s tunes, we played a lot of my tunes which has been really nice, that from the beginning of that, I think the first record was very equal or whatever in the amount of writing. I mean John
basically has always looked for material that we would sound good playing. It doesn’t matter who wrote it. If this works, fine.
